guidelinesCompliance.guideline: New public APIs must be documented.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: All public value objects, enums, methods, and boundary types in stage_transition_output.rs have Rust documentation comments.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep this standalone Weekly Radar output boundary independent of other feature implementations and external systems.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The source uses standard-library fmt only; the integration test loads it with #[path] and source inspection rejects Transformation, Snapshot, and Telegram coupling.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Treat Stage Transition and Candidate status as supplied upstream facts; do not infer from raw Evidence or recalculate historical state.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Constructor stores supplied status and Stage labels; priority maps only explicit labels; focused tests verify Candidate remains Candidate and no forbidden source tokens are present.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep persistence, rendering, Telegram, Scheduler, retry, and receipt behavior outside this Contract.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The standalone source has no persistence, renderer, scheduler, retry, receipt, or delivery API and the source inspection test rejects Telegram coupling.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not add dependencies for this Contract.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Cargo.toml is unchanged; make check succeeds with the existing dependency set.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: If a problem is discovered in the corresponding WI and remains in scope, resolve it in this WI; do not casually open a new WI to prevent scope diffusion.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Captured in Contract, spec, plan, and this Summary.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not introduce trading, price prediction, target price, portfolio allocation, or capital-action behavior.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The implementation and focused tests contain only research transition output facts and no capital-action behavior.

risk.detail: Priority labeling must stay a deterministic mapping over explicit Stage labels; the main remaining risk is accidental scope expansion into Stage judgment or shared-module registration.

observedIssues.issue: Clippy rejected the initial from_stage accessor under wrong_self_convention.
observedIssues.resolution: Renamed the accessor to prior_stage without suppressing the lint; focused tests were updated in the same WI.

observedIssues.resolution: Added the stem-matched module-local stage_transition_output_test.rs and loaded it from the production source with #[cfg(test)] #[path]; the shared coverage policy remains unchanged.

residualRisks.detail: Upstream Stage detection correctness and later shared-module/ACL integration remain outside this WI; the standalone output boundary is validated only for supplied facts.
